segments.text:
I.
BEHOLD the Saviour of Mankind
Nail'd to the ſhameful Tree!
How vaſt the Love that Him inclin'd
To bleed and die for Thee!

II.
Hark how he groans! while Nature ſhakes,
And Earth's ſtrong Pillars bend!
The Temple's Veil in ſunder breaks,
The ſolid Marbles rend.

IV.
But ſoon He'll break Death's envious Chain,
And in full Glory ſhine!
O Lamb of GOD, was ever Pain,
Was ever Love like Thine!
